cultureRule.binding: material-culture.md: two Argonian building cultures are canon and regionally assigned. NEVER blend them in one settlement.

cultures.name: Shadowfen mud/wattle
cultures.description: wattle-and-daub over an exposed log skeleton; round or lumpy shells; walls sweat; sun-blessed mud; ground-level, not stilted

cultures.name: Murkmire reed/stilt
cultures.description: woven reed walls on wooden stilts; platforms extending high into the air, linked to one another, ascending from ground to hover over water and marsh; flexible buoyant timber causeways

cultures.name: Xanmeer (dead layer, not a living culture)
cultures.description: stepped stone pyramids linked by stone bridges; mazelike interiors; vakka-stone mechanisms; maintained as warnings, never inhabited in the modern style. Stone is a moral error post-Duskfall, so no modern Argonian building may read as stone.
cultures.regionHint: province-wide as ruin; densest in the deep interior

cultures.name: Imperial / foreign stone-and-timber
cultures.description: cut stone, mortar, sawn timber, tile and slate; foundations that sank in Murkmire soil; forts, docks, plantations, colonial civic buildings; concentrated where geography and history support it (Gideon, Blackwood, ports)
cultures.regionHint: west/north-west fringe, Topal Bay ports, road corridors

cultures.name: Culturally neutral
cultures.description: containers, tools, rope, rubble, fire, fish gear, generic furniture - readable in any culture's hands

families.gapFlag: ROUND-2 RE-READ: the 9 exterior pieces are a TERRACE KIT, not a dead end. floor (3.63 x 3.61 m slab) + half-floors + wall (3.63 x 3.64 m) + half-walls + wallcorner (4.10 m) + stairs (9.30 m run, 4.75 m rise) is exactly the vocabulary for building one terrace; stack terraces of decreasing footprint and the result IS a stepped pyramid, with the stair rise matching one terrace height. breadthWeOwn.verdict: ROUND 3: the province is buildable. Six of nine gaps are closed - mud-hut variety, xanmeer massing AND ornament, Argonian props, Hist trees (two hero meshes), rafts and canoes - and the drowned layer is newly served with walkable submerged ruin. Five kits are built (mud, stilt, imperial, ruin-monumental, underwater). What remains open is narrow and mostly unsourceable: working/industrial props (saltern, kiln, reed gear - nothing exists on Nexus), true grave-stakes (cairns substitute), and twin-hulled/reed canoes (do not exist). Catalogue authors should treat those three as DESIGN constraints to write around, not as pending deliveries.
breadthWeOwn.roundOverRound: Round 1 named five critical/high gaps and under-searched. Round 2's vault sweep closed two and downgraded one. Round 3's completed 6b sourcing pass closed four more (mud variety, xanmeer exteriors+ornament, rafts, canoes), added the underwater layer, and proved that the three remaining gaps have no Nexus answer at all.

nexusResearch.conducted: 2026-09-02, round 2. RESEARCH ONLY - nothing downloaded. All mod IDs confirmed live against the Nexus API unless flagged unverified.
nexusResearch.method: Nexus v2 GraphQL API (api.nexusmods.com/v2/graphql, same apikey: header) exposes a `mods` query filtering on nameStemmed, description, uploader, author and categoryName. It works from this VM where plain page fetches 403, and is far faster than web search. Filters must be a FLAT dict, one domain at a time (a two-element gameDomainName list ANDs, not ORs). `modFileContents` mesh-filename search exists but returns nothing for Skyrim - not indexed. Recorded so future asset hunts do not re-derive this.
headlineFindings: No true Argonian mud-hut modular kit exists on Nexus. ESO/Murkmire ports do not exist (ZeniMax assets not permitted) and Beyond Skyrim: Argonia has released no public assets. The mud culture will be kitbashed, permanently.
No dugout, outrigger, twin-hulled, reed or raft-village asset exists on Nexus either. Exactly ONE genuine canoe mesh was found. This gap is bound by permissions, not availability.
No banyan or mangrove asset pack exists on Nexus - matching the repo's existing Phase 10 finding.
Skyfall's Sleeping Hist Tree Overhaul is the best purpose-built Hist asset in existence and is canonically correct (the vanilla Sleeping Tree IS a Hist sapling).

round3Corrections: Item 6b sourced EIGHT further pools. Six of round 1's/round 2's nine gaps are now closed: mud-hut variety, xanmeer exteriors AND ornament, Argonian props, Hist tree (two distinct hero meshes), rafts, canoes. The drowned/underwater layer is newly served.

Here There Be Monsters - Sign of Cipactli (SSE 35933) was round 2's 'index, not a source'. That call was WRONG: 6b took it and it is the single biggest win of the phase - 1,579 meshes including purpose-built Black Marsh content (bamboo huts with interiors, a wicker furniture family, Kothringi stilt platform, the Tamu dock/plank family, and a 57-piece xanmeer ruin set carrying exactly the ORNAMENT the Ayleid kit lacks).

The Ayleid Ruins Building Kit (classic 90667) was taken and supplies the 85 EXTERIOR monumental pieces round 2 identified. The owner ruled the 'no porting to other games' clauses APPROVED (standalone Skyrim conversion, private personal use, credited), which unblocked both this and the canoe.

The raft/canoe gap - round 2's top job - is closed. 6b's systematic sweep of both Nexus domains proved the boat scene is almost entirely retextures of one vanilla keeled rowboat; canoe/dugout/punt/skiff/coracle/barge return ZERO mod names. The four keel-less or flat-bottomed hulls that exist anywhere are now all in the vault.

Tropical Skyrim ships NO boat or ship meshes and no boat textures - the 'tropicalised moorings' idea is dead. Its only 'ship' file is a Whiterun building panel. Consistent with round 2's finding that it has no architecture meshes at all.

Hovelmud (SSE 63329), an owner lead, is NOT a mud hut - it is Stroti's Mushroom House kit, a fungal/Telvanni idiom that material-culture puts off-limits inland, and BM&V already bundles the same Stroti material. Recorded so nobody chases it again.
Round 2 flagged that BM&V's 'swamp house.nif' might be the Sniper: Ghost Warrior 2 rip. HTBM bundles a mesh of the same name; the provenance question stands and is recorded under doNotChase.
BM&V extraction is NO LONGER a blocker: 6b's RarSource pulls single members from Data1.rar/Data2.rar on demand in ~0.1 s, so no bulk extraction is needed.
Kits now number FIVE, not the three in the sourcing log's early section: settlement-mud-v1, settlement-stilt-v1, settlement-imperial-v1, ruin-monumental-v1, underwater-v1.

2026-09-04: kits now number EIGHT settlement/dungeon/prop kits plus flora and groundcover. dungeon-root-v1 (124 assets) and settlement-root-v1 (140) close the root-interior and grown-root-architecture gaps that the place-asset-deliverability audit called the two big kit fixes; works-v1 (85) is the substitution vocabulary for the works taxonomy branch.
